n = int(input())
B = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))

cut = 0
odd = 0
even = 0
money = []

for i in range(n):
    if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
        even += 1
    else:
        odd += 1

    if even == odd and even != 0 and i != n - 1:
        money.append(max(arr[i] - arr[i + 1], arr[i + 1] - arr[i]))

money.sort()

for x in money:
    if B >= x:
        cut += 1
        B -= x

print(cut)
</translated_code>
